description: This is an integration test class for the Apache Fineract project, specifically testing the rejection of a loan application for a loan product that uses periodic accrual accounting. The test sets up accounts and a loan product with specific accounting rules, creates a loan application, verifies it is pending approval, then rejects it and checks that the rejection is correctly processed.

classes.name: LoanApplicationRejectionForLoanProductWithPeriodicAccrualAccountingTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that tests the rejection process for a loan application associated with a loan product that has periodic accrual accounting.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the testing environment, including REST-assured setup and request/response specifications.

methods.name: loanApplicationRejectionForPeriodicAccrualAccountingLoanProductTest
methods.description: Main test method that creates accounts and a loan product, submits a loan application, verifies its pending status, then rejects it and verifies the rejection.

methods.name: createLoanProductWithPeriodicAccrualAccounting
methods.description: Creates a loan product configured with periodic accrual accounting rules.

methods.name: createLoanAccount
methods.description: Creates a loan account for a specific client using the specified loan product and external ID.
